parameters.prompt: Compose an ORIGINAL instrumental cue for a sophisticated contemporary dark-romance interactive drama, adult mutual attraction, dangerous secrets, charismatic powerful male lead. Strong emotional tension and immediately recognizable rhythm, not generic ambient wallpaper. Clear on phone speakers through mid-bass harmonics, not only sub-bass. No vocals, words, breathing, choir, spoken samples or environmental effects. Original melody and arrangement, no quotations from existing recordings. Musical sections must visibly change in energy while leaving midrange space for dialogue. 40-second emotionally intense romantic cinematic alt-pop instrumental,88 BPM, D minor moving toward F major add9 without becoming sugary. Echoed clean electric guitar, warm close felt piano, sensual deep bass, soft but definite kick/snare groove, expressive wide legato strings. Start memorable guitar motif within2s; 8-16s drums and bass draw closer; 16-23s rising string countermelody and harmonic suspense; brief beat drop at24s,25-34s heartfelt expansive chord release and full guitar answer;34-40s gentle warm unresolved afterglow. Real push-to-release arc for a mutually chosen intimate moment. Passionate but never bombastic, no vocals or choir.
